Definition: of Hebrew origin (H7346); Roboam (i.e. Rechobam), an Israelite:--Roboam.
BiblicalUsage: Solomon begat Roboam, and Roboam begat Abia, and Abia begat Asa. Roboam is Rehoboam, whose folly split the kingdom his father had built.
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from this is that his name is in the genealogy because grace does not skip the foolish kings.
